label: Род
description: A 10-sentence usage card for род (kin; lineage).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Род' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Наш' is the agreeing masculine possessive, and 'старый' is the nominative predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Род' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'знаю'. 'Свой' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Рода' is in the genitive case after 'история', expressing whose history it is. 'Нашего' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К роду' uses the dative form 'роду' after 'к' to express belonging. 'Древнему' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Родом' is in the instrumental case required by 'гордится'. 'Своим' agrees in the masculine instrumental, marking her own lineage.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В роду' uses the prepositional form 'роду' after 'в' to locate the trait within the family. 'Много врачей' adds a genitive quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Род' is nominative as the subject of 'известен'. 'Этот' points to a specific lineage, and 'своими традициями' gives the instrumental cause of fame.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Роды' is the nominative plural of 'род', acting as the subject of 'хранят'. 'Старые' agrees in the plural, and 'легенды' is the accusative plural object.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of origin. 'Родом' is the instrumental form in the fixed idiom 'я родом из', stating where someone is from. 'Из города' gives the genitive source.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Без рода' uses the genitive form 'рода' after 'без' to express being without one's kin. 'Своего' agrees in the masculine genitive.
